title: General Structure of the Kidney - Histology Lecture
department_desc: Microscopic architecture of renal cortex, filtration barrier, loop of Henle and vasculature
matrix_title: TWISTED MEDICINE LECTURE 6 - HIGH-YIELD HISTOLOGICAL PEARLS & NEPHRON ARCHITECTURE MATRIX

summary_table.content: • Capsule: Dense irregular collagenous CT with contractile myofibroblasts. • Cortical Interstitial Cells: Fibroblast-like cells produce Erythropoietin (EPO) in hypoxia. • Medullary Interstitial Cells: Lipid-laden interstitial cells synthesize PGE2 and Medullipin I (vasodepressor lipid). • Cortex (Granular): Renal corpuscles, PCTs, DCTs, and cortical labyrinths.

• Medullary Rays (Ferrein): Parallel straight tubules (loops of Henle) & collecting ducts radiating from medullary base. • Renal Lobe: 1 pyramid + overlying cortex + 1/2 adjacent Bertin columns (~8-18 per kidney). • Renal Lobule: Central medullary ray + surrounding cortical labyrinths, delimited laterally by Interlobular Arteries. • Nephron Composition: Corpuscle, PCT, loop of Henle, DCT. (Collecting ducts are NOT part of nephron proper).

• Cortical Nephrons (~85%): Superficial corpuscles, short loops in outer medulla, peritubular capillary network. • Juxtamedullary Nephrons (~15%): Near corticomedullary border, long loops deep in inner medulla, Vasa Recta hairpin loops essential for countercurrent urine concentration. • Bowman's Capsule: Parietal layer = simple squamous; Visceral layer = Podocytes (pedicels & filtration slits). • PCT: Simple cuboidal, tall apical Brush Border (microvilli, PAS+), indistinct lateral boundaries (interdigitations), intense
acidophilia/eosinophilia (abundant basal mitochondria), small irregular lumen.

• DCT: Lower simple cuboidal, wider and clear lumen, NO brush border, distinct nuclei, paler cytoplasm. • Macula Densa: Crowded, tall columnar sensory plaque in DCT contacting the vascular pole (chemoreceptor for tubular [NaCI]). • Collecting Ducts: Simple cuboidal-to-columnar, clear lateral cell borders. Principal (Light) cells (Na+ & water reabsorption via ADH) vs.

Intercalated (Dark) cells (acid-base regulation via H+/HC03-). • Ducts of Bellini: Large terminal columnar ducts emptying at Area Cribrosa on papilla. • Special Stains: PAS stains PCT brush border and Glomerular Basement Membrane intensely magenta.

(Collecting ducts are NOT part of nephron proper).
